units.source_text: 虽然可笑，但自己的位置是从京都站起一点一点地向远方移动，

en.t: Ridiculous though it was, my own position was moving little by little farther away from Kyoto Station,

units.source_text: 在保证这种难以置信的思绪方面，只能是这样说了。

en.t: and in order to affirm that unbelievable feeling, there was no other way to put it.

units.source_text: 鹿苑寺之夜，我好几次听见货运列车驶过花园附近的汽笛声，

en.t: On nights at Rokuonji, I had often heard the whistle of freight trains passing near the garden,

units.source_text: 如今自己乘上这趟列车不分昼夜地确实奔向我的远方，

en.t: and now I myself was aboard this train, surely rushing day and night toward my own distance,

units.source_text: 这只能说是一种神奇啊。

en.t: which could only be called a kind of wonder.
